question: On 24th March 2022 the Government of India Department of Biotechnology has launched Data-Driven Research to Eradicate which of the following disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuberculosis**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Bharat Biotech is an Indian biotechnology company that specializes in vaccine research and development.
 
• Biofabri is a Spanish bio-pharmaceutical firm that focuses on the production and commercialization of vaccines and biologics.
 
• The partnership between Bharat Biotech and Biofabri aims to develop a new tuberculosis (TB) vaccine, which is a major public health concern globally.
